targetText: The economic revolution in industry and trade has also largely affected agricultural conditions.
summary: Bebel examines how global grain competition, mortgage indebtedness, and capitalist land concentration ruin small peasants and drive rural populations into industrial cities, aggravating the cleavage between town and country.
